after: Keep every original Git dirty-source and byte comparison. Before each used repository inspection, pin same-user Git layout/configuration bytes and identities, run one exact key-only effective-configuration query, and refuse all filter/include sections or any unknown query result. Recheck every used repository immediately before successful isolated proof. Any concurrent configuration change is refusal.
attributes_scope: Working-tree attributes remain under the original dirty/source checks. With every effective filter section refused, attribute filter names have no external clean/process driver. Environment variables alone are not claimed to make Git independent of repository configuration.
before: The fixed child environment disabled system attributes, hooks, fsmonitor and inherited overrides, but Git status could still execute a repository-local clean or process filter through working-tree attributes. The independent same-size fixture recorded three harmless temporary marker calls.
recorded_values: Canonical input paths, file/directory identities, key-count metadata and byte digests only; no configuration values.
trust: Pinned same-user source/configuration trust plus mutation detection. This is not kernel-enforced immutability or protection against an undetected malicious same-user atomic race.
